scenes.visual: close-up illustration of the black nylon brush strip running along the bottom of a shopping mall escalator's steel side panel, one white sneaker standing on the step beside it, low angle, sharp focus on the brush
scenes.narration: You know that brush along the side of every escalator? Ever wondered what it's actually *for*?

scenes.visual: illustration of a young Indian man on a mall escalator lifting one foot to rub his shoe against the black brush strip on the escalator's side panel, side view, full body, natural pose
scenes.narration: Most of us think it's a shoe cleaner. Honestly, I thought that too. Free polish on the way up!
scenes.headline: FREE SHOE *POLISH*?

scenes.visual: macro illustration looking straight down at the edge of a moving escalator step: the yellow step edge, a thin dark gap, then the black brush strip on the silver side panel
scenes.narration: But look closer. There's a tiny *gap* between the steps and the side wall... <short pause> and it's moving.
scenes.headline: *SKIRT DEFLECTOR*

scenes.visual: close-up illustration of an untied shoelace trailing on an escalator step right at the side edge, next to the black brush strip, tense dramatic light
scenes.narration: A loose lace, the end of a dupatta, even a kid's little finger can get pulled in there.
scenes.headline: THE GAP *PULLS*

scenes.visual: illustration of a child's small pink plastic clog standing on a metal escalator step, a Tokyo train station softly blurred behind
scenes.narration: In Japan, shoes got stuck in escalators *sixty-five* times in just six months. Mostly soft plastic shoes, on small kids.
scenes.headline: JAPAN, *6 MONTHS*

scenes.visual: illustration of a smiling Indian family of three standing in the middle of the escalator steps, holding the handrail, bright modern mall
scenes.narration: So those bristles? They nudge your foot *away* from the gap. <short pause> It's not a cleaner. It's a guard.
scenes.headline: STAND IN THE *MIDDLE*

scenes.visual: illustration of two young Indian friends laughing at a phone screen in a bright shopping mall, an escalator blurred behind them
scenes.narration: Next time you step on one, you'll know. Send this to the friend who still polishes his shoes on it.
scenes.headline: COMMENT *NEXT*
